headline: This law directs Congress leaders to arrange a single Congressional Gold Medal honoring Chinese-American World War II veterans, to be displayed at the Smithsonian Institution.
what_it_does: The law tells the President pro tempore of the Senate and the Speaker of the House to make arrangements for awarding one Congressional Gold Medal to Chinese-American veterans of World War II. It recognizes their service during the war. The medal is to be displayed at the Smithsonian Institution. The Smithsonian is encouraged to lend the medal for display at other places tied to these veterans or to World War II.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 20, 2018.
